test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is 'was.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage is talking about the **past tense**, and the subject **it **is singular. • Therefore, we need** 'was' **in this sentence. • ​Correct sentence:* **It **was** turning out really well.* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** * __ • An infinitive verb is essentially the base form of a verb with the word "to" in front of it. • When you use an infinitive verb, the "to" is a part of the verb. • It is not acting as a preposition in this case.*​* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** * • Passage भूत काल के बारे में बात कर रहा है, और it, विषय एकवचन है। • इसलिए, हमें इस वाक्य में **'was**' की आवश्यकता है। 47:T1545,
